messages.subject: Letter of Response - Hartwell Construction / The Vault Birmingham
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Sirs,

We attach our client's Letter of Response under the Protocol. Liability is denied in full. In short, our client says the abutment was built to your client's facade consultant's design, the pool plant was sized to the Employer's Requirements and the water-quality problems were caused by operational mismanagement and over-occupancy, and the ventilation met the design criteria at the design temperatures. Quantum is disputed in its entirety and our client relies on the Schedule 7 cap.

Our client is willing to attend a without-prejudice meeting.

Yours faithfully,
Olivia Marsh
Drummond Hale LLP

messages.subject: FW: Letter of Response - Hartwell Construction / The Vault Birmingham
messages.plaintextBody:
As expected - blanket denial plus the cap point. Nothing in there that worries me on liability, and the over-occupancy defence runs into trouble because LFA measured the ventilation shortfall with the pool inside the design envelope. We should issue. Catherine's advice will be with us in January.

Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
